info.name: Time Tracker Cards
info.summary: Countdown timers on shareable cards: screen time, cooking, game sessions and more
Nedräkningstimrar på delbara kort: matlagning, speltid, skärmtid och mer
info.description:
Create as many countdown timers as you like and arrange them as cards on your own board. Give each timer a name, an optional note and a length, and invite other users of your Nextcloud: everybody with access sees the same time left, and anyone can start or pause the timer. When the time is up, everybody gets a Nextcloud notification (web, desktop and mobile apps).
A timer is either resettable (an oven timer, a game session) or a daily allowance that cannot be reset by hand and starts over with the full time every day (for example a child's screen time). The cards follow your Nextcloud accent colour, and the app is available in many languages.
This app was developed with the help of AI; see the README for details.
